label: 2. I was walking down the street a couple of days…

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I was walking down the street a couple of days ago

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: when a kid said that I was nice.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Nice?!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I practically had steam coming out of my ears!
Did you give him a good whack?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You dolt!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Nikkes should never strike a human!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Come to think of it, no one should hit a human!
So what did you do?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I gave him some candy.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: That kid's teeth will eventually rot from all the candy he eats.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: He'll have no choice but to go to the dentist!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahahaha!
I see.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: People are starting to forget

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: that I am the ultimate villain.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: How can we remind them? Quick, give me some suggestions!
Let's steal people's things.
Let's cause a ruckus at a store.
There is no answer from Drake.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Sorry for the late reply

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: but it doesn't look like it's worth replying to.
What happened?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I was passing by when I saw

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: that same kid from before.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: He brought a friend and told him I was like a Guardian Angel!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Can you actually believe that?
So, did you give them a wallop?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You donkey-brain! Is that all you can think of?

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You should never hit a child!!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I just gave them both some sweets.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: By tomorrow, they'll both be in the dentist's chair.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Soon enough,

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: everyone will think of me as the ultimate villain once more!
That's right.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Mwahahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I've still got it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: You should be taking notes, dingbat.
Got it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: All right, I'm off to harass more people.
